notes: New in Storage (2.9): the architect's lens for Iceberg and open table formats. When to use one and when not, who owns and pays for it, how it fails, and six under-the-hood answers: the metadata tree, commits from two writers, hidden partitioning, copy-on-write or merge-on-read, compaction with snapshot expiry, and the new version 3 deletion vectors.

The lens covers Iceberg version 3, Amazon S3 Tables and REST catalogs such as Polaris; module 8 (8.5) adds the catalog products and links to the lens. Three new interview questions, three quiz questions and eight reels.
